name: WeatherAPI
description: Global current weather, up to 3-day hourly forecasts, and location search using WeatherAPI.com. Requires an API key; the free plan includes these tools. Forecast requests are limited to 3 days for free-plan compatibility.

credential_fields.name: api_key
credential_fields.label: API Key
credential_fields.description: Sign up at https://www.weatherapi.com/signup.aspx and copy your API key from the account dashboard.

tools.name: get_current_weather
tools.description: Get current conditions for a location. The response includes both metric and imperial measurements.

q.description: Location: city name, latitude,longitude, postal code, or id:<id> from search_locations. Use coordinates or a search result ID to disambiguate cities.

lang.description: Language code for weather descriptions, for example en, fr, or es.

tools.name: get_forecast
tools.description: Get daily and hourly forecasts for 1 to 3 days, including current weather and location metadata. Both metric and imperial values are returned.

q.description: Location: city name, latitude,longitude, postal code, or id:<id> from search_locations. Use coordinates or a search result ID to disambiguate cities.

days.description: Number of forecast days, including today. The free plan supports up to 3 days.

lang.description: Language code for weather descriptions, for example en, fr, or es.

tools.name: search_locations
tools.description: Search for locations by name or postal code. Use a returned id as q=id:<id>, or use the returned latitude and longitude in weather tools.

q.description: City name or postal code to search, e.g. London or 75001.
